request.description: Starts an email/password signup. Does NOT create the account and returns no tokens. Always answers 202 { status: 'pending_verification' } for a well-formed body, whether or not the email already has an account (no account enumeration). The work runs after the response: no account -> a 6-digit code is emailed (60s cooldown and max 5 codes/24h, both applied silently); existing account -> a 'you already have an account' email (max 1 per 15 min), the account is not touched; deleted account -> nothing. 400 VALIDATION_ERROR only for an invalid email or a password shorter than 8 characters. The password is validated but NOT stored: send it again with the code to POST /auth/signup/verify. Rate limited per IP (config.rateLimit.auth.signup).
Join the waitlist with an email address. Rate limited to 20 requests per hour per IP.

Log in with email and password. Rate limited to 30 requests per minute per IP and 10 per 15 minutes per email (429 request.rateLimitExceeded with Retry-After). No account enumeration: unknown email, OAuth-only account (no password) and wrong password all answer 401 { error: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', messageCode: 'auth.invalidCredentials' } with the same scrypt cost (PASSWORD_NOT_SET / 409 is no longer returned). A soft-deleted account (see DELETE /me) answers 403 { error: 'USER_DELETED', messageCode: 'auth.user.deleted', message: <translated>, details: {} } only when the password matches.

Request a password reset email containing a 6-digit code (use it as `code` in POST /auth/reset-password together with the same email). The `resetToken` field (the 6-digit code) is returned in the 200 body ONLY in development/test (config.auth.exposeResetTokenInResponse); it is never present in staging or production. Always answers the same 200 whether or not the email has an account. Rate limited to 20 requests per hour per IP and 3 per hour per email (429 request.rateLimitExceeded with Retry-After).

request.description: Reset password using the email and the 6-digit code received via email (valid for 15 minutes, max 5 attempts per code). The code is bound to the email. Body: `password` and `passwordConfirmation` are required; `email` + `code` are the current contract. DEPRECATED: the legacy `token` field (the same 6-digit code, sent WITHOUT `email`) is still accepted temporarily for old mobile versions - see the 'Reset Password (legacy token, deprecated)' request. If `email` is present, `token` is ignored. Unknown email, wrong, expired, already-used code and too many attempts all return the same 400 PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID_CODE / passwordReset.invalidCode (no account enumeration); 403 USER_DELETED is no longer returned. A body with neither a usable `email`+`code` nor `token` returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR / passwordReset.codeRequired.

request.description: DEPRECATED, temporary. Legacy body of old mobile versions: 6-digit `token` without `email`. Matched against all active codes; answers the same 400 PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID_CODE unless exactly one matches. Throttled by global buckets of 30 requests/min and 100 requests/hour (429 request.rateLimitExceeded); after 30 wrong codes within an hour a process-local circuit breaker answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR / passwordReset.codeRequired until restart. Will be removed after the mobile release that sends email + code. Use 'Reset Password' instead.

Start Google OAuth flow for browser. Redirects to Google for authentication. New users start with no roles.

Log in with Google ID Token from mobile native SDK. Returns JWT tokens for mobile app authentication. If the account was soft-deleted (see DELETE /me), returns 403 with the full unified error contract: { error: 'USER_DELETED', messageCode: 'auth.user.deleted', message: <translated>, details: {} }. This was standardized in this PR — it previously replied with just { error: 'Account deactivated' } (no messageCode, no details), so a translated message never reached the client for this route. Known remaining debt (NOT fixed in this PR, same bare-string reply): /auth/signup, /auth/google/callback, /auth/change-password (no messageCode/details at all), and /auth/refresh (has error: USER_DELETED but no messageCode/details). /auth/reset-password, /auth/apple/mobile, and /auth/google/web already had the full contract.

Sign in with Apple (mobile native). Validates the identityToken from the iOS Sign in with Apple SDK against Apple's JWKS and returns a session. Returns 200 for existing users and 201 when a new account is created on first login. The optional nonce (raw value) is validated against the SHA-256 claim in the token.
Log in with Firebase ID Token from web frontend (signInWithPopup with GoogleAuthProvider). Returns JWT tokens for web app authentication.

**Rotate refresh token and get new access token**

Exchanges a refresh token for a NEW access token AND a NEW refresh token. The old refresh token is revoked and cannot be used again (token rotation).

**Important:** The NEW refreshToken returned in the response must be stored and used for subsequent refresh requests.

**Token Rotation Flow:**
1. Client sends old refresh token
2. Server validates token (not revoked, not expired, user active)
3. Server revokes old token (marks rotatedAt)
4. Server issues new refresh token (valid for 7 days)
5. Server issues new access token (valid for 15 minutes)
6. Client must update stored refreshToken with new value

**Security Benefits:**
- Each refresh token can only be used once
- Stolen tokens expire quickly when rotated
- Sessions continue indefinitely while user active

**Error Codes:**
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (400): No token provided
- `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN` (401): Token not found or malformed
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REVOKED` (401): Token already used/revoked
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED` (401): Token expired (7 days)
- `USER_DELETED` (403): Account deactivated
- `REFRESH_FAILED` (500): Server error

Permanently soft-delete and anonymize the authenticated user's own account (App Store guideline 5.1.1(v) / Google Play account deletion compliance). Only available for plain (student) accounts today — an account with an active Trainer or Nutritionist profile gets 409 instead (see below); that professional graph (billing, linked students/patients, branding, protocols) needs its own teardown design and is tracked as separate follow-up work.

Clears PII on the user row (email, username, password hash, first/last name, gender, birth date, avatar) and sets deletedAt. Deletes linked OAuth/email accounts, refresh tokens, password reset tokens, address, social networks, health details, preferences, metabolic profile, workout sessions (and their exercise/set logs), anamnesis responses, AI conversations, gamification records (points/challenges), trainer-student/nutritionist-patient links where this user is the student/patient, and trainer invites addressed to or redeemed by this user (by userId and by email).

Scrubbed, not deleted: AiInteractionLog rows where this user was the student in a trainer's AI conversation about them keep the row (trainer diagnostic record + beta usage metrics) but have studentId/userMessage/responseText nulled — that's specifically where this user's PII could appear.

Retained (not deleted): subscription/payment records (tax/accounting reasons), and any TrainingProtocol/DietProtocol assigned to this user (trainer/nutritionist-owned content). Clearing the email frees it up for a future signup with the same address — note a prior accepted trainer invite is deleted, not restored, so a fresh signup does not automatically regain beta access.

Irreversible.

Returns 204 on success (no body). Returns 403 (error: USER_DELETED, messageCode: auth.user.deleted) if the account was already deleted previously. Returns 404 (error: USER_NOT_FOUND, messageCode: resource.notFound) if the user row is not found (edge case). Returns 409 (error: PROFESSIONAL_ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNSUPPORTED, messageCode: account.deletion.professionalUnsupported) if the account has an active Trainer or Nutritionist profile. Rate limited: 3 requests/hour in production (1000/hour in dev/staging).

Set the user's active profile to trainer. This adds the TRAINER role and creates a trainer profile if it doesn't exist. Returns new tokens with updated roles. During closed beta, may also return 403 with messageCode "invite.required" if the user has no admin/trainer role and no accepted trainer invite — redeem an invite first via POST /invite/redeem.

Set the user's active profile to nutritionist (adds the NUTRITIONIST role and creates the nutritionist profile). Returns new tokens with updated roles. Requires beta access: 403 INVITE_REQUIRED (messageCode "invite.required") if the user has no admin/trainer role and no accepted invite. Rate limited: 3 requests/hour.

request.description: Finalize (submit) the response to an anamnesis. All required visible questions must be answered. The payload fully replaces all previously stored answers and the response is marked as submitted (status "submitted"). If a draft was saved earlier via PATCH /my/anamneses/:anamnesisId/response/draft, it is converted into the submitted response. Re-submitting is allowed (idempotent upsert, always 200). The anamnesis must be linked to the student's account. The response becomes student-authored (filledBy "student", studentConfirmedAt set), also when it corrects a response the trainer filled on the student's behalf.

Save a partial (draft) response to an anamnesis. Upserts only the answers present in the payload (1 to 300 items, no duplicate questionId); other stored answers are untouched. An empty value (null, blank string or empty array) clears that question's stored answer. Required questions are NOT validated and answers of currently hidden conditional questions are kept. Drafts are invisible in the trainer dossier (GET /trainer/students/:studentId/anamneses/:anamnesisId/response) until the response is finalized with POST /my/anamneses/:anamnesisId/response; the trainer only sees a student draft through the fill flow after attesting the student is present. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid body or duplicate questionId), 404 ANAMNESIS_NOT_LINKED_TO_STUDENT / ANAMNESIS_QUESTION_NOT_FOUND, 409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED once the response was finalized.

Replacing an active plan voids only the replaced plan's pending charges starting on or after the new first cycle start (a same-day replace leaves exactly one pending cycle); every older charge stays billable at full price, and for a future-dated start the old plan's missing cycles before the new start are created at replacement time so it keeps billing until then. Optional billingDay (integer 1-31) overrides the plan's billingDay and is stored on the subscription; when omitted, the plan's billingDay is used, falling back to the day of startDate.
